mentions.name: Svpply reboot
mentions.description: A reboot of Svpply, the author's previously shuttered startup, focused on curating excellent clothes, shoes, and artisanal pocketknives; the timing feels off because the economy has closed the window when such goods were attainable.
mentions.problem: With the economy going the way it is, pitching luxury-adjacent goods feels grotesque; the window when luxury goods were attainable and normal people could pay for necessities has closed.
mentions.source_excerpt: - a reboot of Svpply, my own shuttered startup. I'd love to just make (another) thing that's about excellent clothes and shoes and artisanal pocketknives, but the way the economy is going, this feels grotesque. I was lucky to make it the first time when luxury goods were attainable _and_ normal people could pay for necessities; that window has closed.
